data.name: Evelina
data.gender_notes: Evelina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'Eva' meaning life, and 'Lina' meaning little. It means 'little one' or 'evolving one'. The name Evelina carries the meaning “Little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Evelina usually hope their child will grow to embody little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of growth and evolution, symbolizing the journey of the soul.
data.etymology: Evelina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Evelina total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Evelina was popular in the English-speaking world during the 18th and 19th centuries. It gained prominence in literature, particularly in works by the renowned English novelist, Sir Walter Scott. One of his famous novels, "Heart of Midlothian," features a leading character named Evelina. The name also appears in other works by authoriles such as Flaubert, Austen, and Hemingway.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Evelina carries a deeper spiritual meaning beyond its literal translation. It can be seen as a reminder of our worth as God's little creations, constantly evolving and growing in our faith and as individuals. The name Evelina can serve as a constant reminder of the divine love and guidance always present in our lives. It encourages us to embrace our unique spiritual journey and to trust that God has a plan for us.
